page.overview:
Who is King of Baron?

The King of Baron is a character from Final Fantasy IV. He is the ruler of Baron and the adoptive father of Cecil Harvey and Kain Highwind.

The King is a man with brown or purple hair and beard. In his youth, he wore a silver suit of armor with a floor-length luxurious red mantle with a white collar. His weapon was a silver longsword. In present time, his hair and beard have grown long and grayed. He wears a long red robe and a golden crown with red jewels.

Though a benevolent and kindhearted ruler for many years, even taking the orphaned Cecil and Kain under his wing, the King's demeanor has recently changed. He has ordered his people to do questionable things, such as stealing the Water Crystal from Mysidia. This change worries some of his inner circle, especially Kain and Cecil.

The King of Baron once found an infant under a tree outside Baron. As the infant reminded him of Cecilia, he named him Cecil, and raised him to be a Dark Knight. He wanted Kain to be raised likewise, but he wanted to follow in his father's footsteps to become a Dragoon. The King promoted Cecil to the captain of the Red Wings due to his fealty to the Crown.
